endorsements.quote: Loss of availability is a predictable failure mode and needs to be addressed.

unlisted_practices: Use ward-level digital twins to generate risk scores and prioritization rankings that guide targeted in-person triage when remote patient monitoring or hospital-at-home systems lose availability.
Obtain informed consent from patients, including disclosure that the digital twin may inform prioritization during periods of degraded system availability.
Articulate accountability for harm contributed to by DT-informed triage decisions before clinical deployment.
Assess digital twin risk scores for systematically lower scores in patient subgroups, since bias could delay care during outages.
Develop DT-specific validation frameworks for approval of digital twin-based risk scoring as a medical device.

screen.reason: This is a framework/proposal article suggesting the integration of digital twins to enhance the resilience and safety of remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home systems.
